Constructed falsifying path `docs/notes-about-skills/implement/phases/x.md` (a non-implement, non-review path) yields `skills/implement/phases/x.md` -- i.e. it IS attributed to an implement phase, because the substring 'skills/implement/phases/' occurs mid-string inside '...about-skills/implement/phases/...'. A real `skills/review/phases/phase-1-setup.md` path correctly returns None, so the comment's narrow claim about review-engine files specifically holds for realistic review paths, but the broader universal (full-path matching via the trailing slash makes misattribution of any non-implement path impossible) is false: an unanchored substring elsewhere in the path can still trigger false attribution.
